title: Federation of Australia
summary: On 1 January 1901 six self-governing British colonies united as the Commonwealth of Australia; Edmund Barton served as caretaker prime minister and was returned as prime minister at the March 1901 election.

notes.problem: Source does not use 'first prime minister'; it says Barton 'was the caretaker Prime Minister of Australia at the inaugural national election' and 'The election returned Barton as prime minister'.
